texts.label: text
texts.orig: When I was a kid, my family owned a VCR that weighed about 750 pounds and was attached to the remote control by a cord as thick as a toddler’s forearm. When I wasn’t using it as a remote, it doubled as a trip wire that I would use to knock my brother, Jeremy, on his ass when he ran through the living room.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Exaggeration is only funny when it’s clear that you are exaggerating to produce a laugh. Exaggerating in the hope of getting people to believe it is true is called lying.
